description: Create a new hidden product in a Fudge draft, with options, variants, prices and media. It is deleted if the draft is discarded and becomes active when the merchant publishes. Use only when the merchant asks.

collections.description: Collection ids/GIDs the product joins (manual membership).

files.description: Existing Shopify file GIDs (e.g. from media uploads) to attach as product media.

giftCard.description: Gift-card product — set only at creation, immutable afterwards.

handle.description: URL handle; derived from the title when omitted.

options.description: Product options (max 3), e.g. [{name: "Size", values: ["S", "M"]}]. Omit for a single-variant product.

barcodes.description: Complete barcode list in its existing order. Preserve other entries when editing; [] clears all. Never invent identifiers.

type.description: Use the merchant or supplier’s declared type; never infer it.

options.description: One value per product option, in the same order as `options` (e.g. ["S", "Black"]).

price.description: Decimal string in the shop currency, e.g. "19.99".

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: create_draft_product
title: Create product in draft
